'''2016 European Championship Day 3 Jimmy Faelens DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jimmy Faelens]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jimmy Faelens]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125837/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
